metadata.title: fix(tests): resolve UI test suite failures across auth, CSRF, and password policy
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

Fixes multiple root causes of Playwright UI test failures in the latest test suite run.

### Changes

**Password Policy Compliance**
- Update all test passwords to 22+ character random strings that meet the strict password policy requirements
- Fixes the \"Password must not be based on your username\" validation error that caused the forced password-change flow to fail
- Resolves the `ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS` loop that occurred when password change failed and the user was bounced between `/admin/login` and `/admin`

**Admin Authentication & Redirects**
- Refactor `AdminAuthMiddleware` to use the shared `validate_token_user` from `mcpgateway/auth.py` instead of hand-rolled JWT verification
- Fix `admin_login_page` to properly check admin access (`is_admin` or RBAC admin permission) before redirecting authenticated users to `/admin`
- Non-admin users with valid tokens now correctly see the login page instead of being redirected into a permission-denied loop

**CSRF Protection**
- Add CSRF token to `getAuthHeaders()` in `auth.js` and `fetchWithTimeout()` in `utils.js`
- Add `/rpc` to `csrf_exempt_paths` in `config.py` — JSON-RPC is a programmatic protocol, not a browser form submission
- Fixes viewer cookie RPC tools call returning 403 from CSRF middleware

**UI JavaScript Fixes**
- Guard all `window.Admin` assignments with `typeof` checks to prevent `ReferenceError` when functions are defined inside `DOMContentLoaded` callbacks
- Add missing `openCreateTeamModal`/`closeCreateTeamModal` to `window.Admin` so delegated click handlers work
- Fix `toggleDropdownImportMethod` and related dropdown functions

**Infrastructure**
- Apply nginx `\$forwarded_host` map to `nginx.conf`, `nginx-tls.conf`, and Helm chart `configmap-nginx-proxy.yaml`
- Preserves `X-Forwarded-Host` header through the proxy chain for forwarded-host redirect hint tests

**Data & Permissions**
- Converge permissions on existing system roles in `bootstrap_db.py` instead of skipping them
- Ensures the `viewer` role receives `servers.use` permission on stale databases

### Testing

- All Playwright UI tests now pass after the password policy fix
- Verified RPC 403 is resolved after `/rpc` CSRF exemption
- Verified redirect loop no longer occurs with single replica

### Files Changed

35 files changed, 412 insertions(+), 251 deletions(-)

commits.message:
fix(tests): resolve UI test suite failures across auth, CSRF, and password policy

Fix multiple root causes of Playwright UI test failures:

Password Policy Compliance:
- Update all test passwords to 22+ character random strings meeting policy
- Fixes "Password must not be based on your username" validation error
- Prevents redirect loop caused by failed password-change flow

Admin Auth & Redirects:
- Refactor AdminAuthMiddleware to use shared validate_token_user
- Fix admin_login_page to check admin access before redirecting to /admin
- Resolve ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS on logged-in user login-page access

CSRF Protection:
- Add CSRF token to getAuthHeaders and fetchWithTimeout
- Add /rpc to csrf_exempt_paths for JSON-RPC protocol requests
- Fix viewer cookie RPC tools call 403

UI JavaScript Fixes:
- Guard window.Admin assignments with typeof checks for DOMContentLoaded
- Add openCreateTeamModal/closeCreateTeamModal to window.Admin
- Fix toggleDropdownImportMethod ReferenceError

Infrastructure:
- Apply forwarded_host map to nginx configs and Helm chart
- Preserve X-Forwarded-Host header through proxy chain

Data & Permissions:
- Converge permissions on existing system roles in bootstrap_db
- Ensure viewer role gets servers.use permission

Files changed:
- .env.example
- mcpgateway/admin.py, main.py, auth.py, config.py, bootstrap_db.py
- mcpgateway/middleware/rbac.py
- mcpgateway/admin_ui/*.js
- mcpgateway/templates/*.html
- infra/nginx/*.conf
- charts/mcp-stack/templates/configmap-nginx-proxy.yaml
- tests/playwright/conftest.py and test files
- tests/js/admin-async.test.js

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>

commits.message:
test: add unit tests for diff coverage gaps

Add tests covering missing lines from the UI test fixes diff:

Admin login RBAC (admin.py):
- Non-admin with valid token + RBAC admin permission → redirect to /admin
- Non-admin with valid token + no RBAC permission → render login page
- Token revocation success and 404 paths

Auth validation (auth.py):
- validate_token_user with empty token raises TokenValidationError
- validate_token_user with generic exception raises TokenValidationError

Bootstrap DB (bootstrap_db.py):
- System role permission convergence when schema changes

AdminAuthMiddleware (main.py):
- _auth_error_param mappings for disabled/expired/idle timeout
- Proxy auth platform admin bootstrap
- Proxy auth user not found → 401
- Proxy auth disabled user → 403
- HTTPException and generic exception handling in dispatch

Security headers (security_headers.py):
- root_path stripping for CSP skip check on docs endpoints

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
